set.acceptance_criteria: A decision is recorded, and either the plug lands with tests or the SPEC files say plainly that the ports are configuration only.
set.body:
The eight sol<n>_<slug>_agent_sdk and _deep_agents folders return runtime configuration and enforce write scope. They do not drive the loop.

Driving it needs a doer plug. loops/researcher.run already takes a research.Backend object. loops/implementer.run and loops/fixer.run take doer as a string, and loops/enhancer.run has no plug at all.

Widening doers.build to pass a Backend through follows the precedent researcher already sets. The enhancer would need a new plug point in loops/.
set.title: Decide how far run() goes on the eight runtime ports

set.acceptance_criteria: No Taskfile.yml under labs/ or solutions/ (other than the repo root's own) has an includes: block. No loop.py under labs/ or solutions/ imports from loops.* or solutions.* (the shared root packages).
set.body: Labs and solutions must not share Python modules or a base Taskfile. Each lab/solution folder runs on its own, start to finish, even if that means duplicate files across folders. solutions/sol1_enhancer (the Claude Code plugin) is the reference pattern: own Taskfile with no includes, no imports from the repo-root loops/ or solutions/ packages. Repeat that pattern for every remaining lab and solution folder, phase by phase, one module at a time.
set.title: Make every lab and solution folder standalone

set.acceptance_criteria: Running python scripts/build_labs.py does not modify any file under labs/lab1_enhancer or solutions/sol1_enhancer*.
set.body: scripts/build_labs.py still regenerates labs/lab1_enhancer and every solutions/sol1_enhancer* folder from LABS_SPEC. Lab 1 was hand-redefined as a Claude Code plugin (commit 66573fc) and no longer matches what the generator would produce, so re-running it would clobber that work. Remove the lab1_enhancer entry from LABS_SPEC (or otherwise skip it), so labs 2 through 4 still regenerate normally but lab 1 and its solution family are left alone. scripts/build_done_branches.sh also references lab1_enhancer in its SLUGS array and will need the same exclusion once the done-m branches are retired.
set.title: Stop the generator from touching lab 1 / solution 1

set.acceptance_criteria: git branch -a shows no done-m1..done-m4, locally or under remotes/origin. scripts/build_done_branches.sh is removed.
set.body: FALL-BEHIND.md in every lab already points attendees at the matching solutions/sol<n>_* folder to copy from, not at a done-m<n> branch. The done-m1..done-m4 branches (local and on origin) and scripts/build_done_branches.sh, which builds them, are the old way and are no longer referenced anywhere. Delete the four local branches, the four origin branches, and retire the build script.
set.title: Delete the done-m1..done-m4 fall-behind branches

set.acceptance_criteria: None of the five folders' loop.py imports loops.* or solutions.*. None of the five folders' Taskfile.yml has an includes: block. Each folder's tests (or a small self-check) still pass standalone.
set.body: solutions/sol1_enhancer_codex, _grok_build, and _opencode each import 'from loops import criteria, gates' and 'from loops.ticket import Ticket' via _root.py's sys.path hack. solutions/sol1_enhancer_agent_sdk and _deep_agents import loops.contract.Contract, loops.roles, and solutions.roleplan the same way. All five also have a Taskfile.yml that is just an includes: block pulling in the root Taskfile. Copy the needed source (ticket.py, criteria.py, gates.py for the three tool variants; contract.py, roles.py, roleplan.py for the two runtime-port variants) into each folder as local files, point loop.py's imports at the local copies, drop _root.py where it is no longer needed, and replace each Taskfile.yml's includes: block with a small standalone one. solutions/sol1_enhancer (the Claude Code plugin) is already done and is the reference pattern; do not touch it.
